title: Attention All Cars: The Night Gordie Howe Caught the Rocket
deck: November 10, 1963. Two weeks stuck on a tied record, a shorthanded rush at the Olympia, and a police radio that told all of Detroit. The goal that took the record from Maurice Richard.
